verdict.rationale: New Relic's own docs say you can build and share dashboards with tailored charts and visualizations, including public live-dashboard URLs and 'custom, high-density interactive visualizations'. Nothing in the evidence covers template or dashboard variables, which is a core part of the story. Missing for 10: documented template/dashboard variables, a specific catalog of visualization types, dashboards-as-code definition (e.g., Terraform or API dashboard resources), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can build shareable dashboards with rich visualization types and template variables

citations.quote: Through our UI you can build and share tailored user-friendly charts and visualizations.
Share dashboards with stakeholders outside your New Relic organization via publicly accessible live dashboard URLs.
Drive insight with custom, high-density interactive visualizations with a consistent UI.
